title: Draft candidate κ ≈ 0.001289283116: R715 shared kernel, retiming and whole pooling
body:
Draft candidate on PR463's R715 word: exact aggregate bit saving **0.001290947513026212877942**, projecting **κ ≈ 0.001289283116193776** with PR458's unchanged complex supplier. This is about **0.45% above PR465's reported κ**.

**Submitted before full verification at the user's request. This is a projected gain, not an admitted final κ or completed full replay.**

The new construction uses 99 shared-donor pivots (entrance rank118), 56 target-prefix receivers, 60 single-gate retimings and14 connected-pair retimings, then pools four replicas. Each helper residual stays entirely on one physical family; there is no PR448/450 cross-family split. The finite global profile has4,800 live families and deficit1,632.

Completed discovery checks: exact rational-span/F2 local replay on all955 columns; exact whole-residual assignment; two independent rational moment engines with adjacent-grid rejection. The frozen aggregate bit root is645473756513106438971/500000000000000000000000. Four and eight replicas give the same normalized root in this screen.

`research/r715-kernel-pool/` includes the actual final word, source word, kernel/retiming/pooling selections, scoped evidence and a standalone component reconstruction wrapper. Its first packaged replay is still pending at submission. The published PR463 snapshot contains the pre-kernel word but not its claimed final mixed word; this package reconstructs its own selection independently from the supplied pre-kernel word.

Still pending: emitted global ownership and routes; new physical-family register-growth bound and finite invoice; independent operator audit; strict final outer assembly; fresh full-parent replay; CI. Do not treat the arithmetic ceiling c/(1+c) as an admitted theorem. The inherited whole-hosting, compiler, mutable-basis/target-label, compressed-window, restored-work, common-grid, precision, row and analytic assumptions remain.

Credits: DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus5.5 for PR463's carrier/XOR word and target mixing; chafreaky and PR417 for shared-donor packing and exact engines; DaysSky for whole hosting; PR458's complex supplier; all inherited E8/bridge contributors. New selections, retiming and four-replica pooling by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex. Licenses and notices retained.
